csv_scope_of_work: The City of Cheyenne ( City ) is currently seeking proposals for the following work as specified: The City of Cheyenne, Wyoming is seeking qualification statements and service proposals from consulting groups for the Design of the New City of Cheyenne Fleet Maintenance Mechanic Shop located at 2731 Old Happy Jack Road, Cheyenne, Wyoming. The City of Cheyenne is looking to add a new mechanic shop to the Fleet Maintenance Facility. As the City grows, more space is needed to accommodate vehicle repairs for its expanding fleet. The new mechanic shop will need to contain approximately 6 bays with plenty of storage for tools, equipment, supplies, etc, a paint booth, one set of bathrooms, and a small office space. Features will include extra ventilation for welding, two oil pits, and one lift
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering

title: Fleet Maintenance Mechanic Shop Design
short_description: Design services for a new six-bay fleet maintenance mechanic shop in Cheyenne.
project_location: 2731 Old Happy Jack Road, Cheyenne, Wyoming, USA
project_scope: Design of a new mechanic shop addition at the City of Cheyenne Fleet Maintenance Facility to support an expanding municipal vehicle fleet. The facility is to include approximately 6 maintenance bays, storage for tools, equipment, and supplies, a paint booth, one set of bathrooms, a small office space, extra ventilation for welding, two oil pits, and one vehicle lift.
services: Consulting and design services including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a functional municipal maintenance building with no indication of notable structural complexity or long spans.
- Scope is focused on architectural and general facility design rather than advanced structural engineering.
- No bridge, stadium, special roof, facade, tower, or architecturally demanding building features are described.
- Could involve some industrial building structure input, but the available information suggests limited strategic fit for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender notice. Available scope information for estimating includes a new fleet maintenance shop with about 6 bays, storage, paint booth, bathrooms, office, welding ventilation, two oil pits, and one lift; however, no area, structural system, or cost basis is provided, so a realistic estimate is not reliable.
fee_explanation: No design fee or fee basis is stated in the tender notice. Since neither construction cost nor detailed scope by discipline is provided, a reliable sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualification statements and service proposals are requested from consulting groups. Firms must attend the mandatory pre-proposal meeting and sign the attendance sheet; otherwise proposals will be rejected. No specific reference counts or minimum qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
